meta.title: feat(telemetry): implement performance testing framework (Phase 8)
meta.body_summary: Add testing infrastructure (MockTransport, test helpers), integration/e2e tests, performance benchmarks, and optimized fast-path capture using atomic flag to minimize telemetry overhead when disabled.

perf_labels.notes: Claude Code added new telemetry testing/benchmarking infrastructure with 2.4ns disabled-ops; CodeRabbit flagged Go idioms and concurrency issues; all addressed and merged within ~1h.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: Large addition (2304 lines) but entirely new test/benchmark infrastructure and telemetry optimizations in a single package. Merged after rapidly addressing bot review feedback within ~1 hour. Fits a substantial but self-contained perf PR with strong evidence.

review_details.concern_detail: CodeRabbit bot review requested adding t.Parallel() to subtests, replacing time.Sleep with channels, using errors.As, moving production functions out of test files, and updating telemetry state on settings change. All substantive feedback was addressed before merge.
review_details.performance_claim: Telemetry disabled path achieves 2.4ns per operation, 1.3ns atomic check, zero allocations.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Complex Go performance optimization and benchmarking required following idiomatic Go patterns (t.Parallel, errors.As, avoiding time.Sleep in tests). Bot review caught non-idiomatic usage, and the agent rapidly addressed them, enabling a smooth merge.

detection_detail.benchmark: Maintainer relied on the included benchmark suite verifying sub-5ns disabled telemetry overhead and zero allocations.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes comprehensive unit, integration, e2e, and benchmark tests with clear performance claims and runnable commands.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Addressed multiple bot review comments regarding test parallelism, channel vs. Sleep, error handling, and config synchronization before merging.

core_change_summary.description: Adds MockTransport, test/benchmark infrastructure, and optimized fast-path capture functions to the telemetry package. The main performance change is using an atomic.Bool to skip telemetry operations when disabled, reducing overhead to ~2.4ns and zero allocations.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Additional test files (integration, e2e, unit, async) validate the full telemetry pipeline. Settings handlers now update telemetry flag on changes.
change_trajectory: feat: MockTransport and test helpers added.
perf: benchmarks and optimized atomic flag capture.
test: async behavior tests and TelemetryWorker recommendation.
refactor: address CodeRabbit feedback (t.Parallel, errors.As, etc.).
fix: runtime config sync for telemetry flag.
